dedupe_keys.name: climate adaptive data center cooling across u s climate zones energy water trade offs and waste heat assisted atmospheric water harvesting code and data

description: Akshay Nagle and colleagues publish data-centre cooling models for seven United States climate zones. Zenodo archives 21 EnergyPlus 25.1 models, one for each city and three cooling architectures, plus hourly outputs, sizing reports, TMY3 weather and a Python atmospheric-water-harvesting model. Its description assigns MIT to the Python code and CC BY 4.0 to models and outputs. Modellers can compare chiller electricity, water use and waste-heat-assisted atmospheric-water recovery across climate simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this 21-run suite; EnergyPlus is a separate parent engine. Coverage is the seven selected city weather files and specified designs, not measured operation of every data centre. A limitation is that cooling architecture, weather year and assumed equipment efficiencies determine the trade-off; the included TMY3 files may carry upstream terms. The associated article title is named, but publication status was not verified. No model or weather file was downloaded, and hourly energy or water results were not reproduced.
